description: Free. Creates a QR code for a URL. Returns the PNG image, a hosted copy of it (imageUrl), the SVG markup when format is "svg", and for "direct" codes a pageUrl where the code can be viewed and downloaded. "redirect" codes encode a scan link (scanUrl) that counts scans, and their destination can be changed later by an owner with Pro. Without an API key the result includes a claimUrl, valid for 30 days, that adds the code to the QR codes of whoever opens it on QRCodeDinosaur.com. Unsafe links and links to private or internal hosts are refused with an error that names the reason.

format.description: "png" (default) returns a hosted PNG. "svg" also returns the SVG markup.

url.description: Where the QR code should send people. https:// is added if no scheme is given.

variant.description: "direct" (default) encodes the URL itself. "redirect" encodes a scan link that counts scans and whose destination can be changed later.

name: create_qr_code
title: Create a QR code
